# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 and managed perf work** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 upgrades to Skia m151 and ports several hot paths to allocation-free managed C#. This release lands a batch of managed performance work — color conversion, premultiplication, HarfBuzz shaping, and tag/color parsing all move off native round-trips or hidden allocations — plus new .NET 11 WASM assets and native resource-leak fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia upgraded to milestone m151** — The bundled Skia engine is now built from chrome/m151, with several follow-up bug-fix syncs merged in during the preview cycle. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## API Surface

- **Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 WASM** — Adds prebuilt Emscripten 5.0.6 native libraries and a preview-.NET WASM test job so the WASM runtime tracks upcoming .NET 11 exception-handling changes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak fixed in SKImage.FromEncodedData** — The overload that accepts an SKRectI subset no longer leaks a native resource when decoding fails. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **CPU raster regression fixed by restoring legacy shader context support** — Re-enables SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to correct a CPU raster rendering regression introduced upstream. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Several hot paths ported to managed C# for fewer allocations and less P/Invoke overhead** — SKColor↔SKColorF conversion, SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply, HarfBuzzSharp buffer/tag parsing, SKShaper glyph reads, and SKColor hex parsing now avoid native round-trips and per-call allocations, with no observable behaviour change. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345), [#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Ports Buffer.AddUtf8 and Tag.Parse to allocation-free managed implementations and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1.
